title: What It Actually Looks Like to Work Hard and Rest Like He Means It
caption:
A godly man works like it matters and rests like he means it. Both are obedience. Neither is optional.

Work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord. Colossians 3:23 isn't a productivity quote. It's who you're actually working for.

God rested on the seventh day before anyone had earned anything. Stop calling burnout discipline. A tired, hollow man isn't more faithful, he's just tired.

Let Sunday actually be Sunday. That's faith with a body attached.
